newsitem.title: UK: Pearson up as NatWest, Merill positive.
newsitem.headline: Pearson up as NatWest, Merill positive.

text.p: Shares in media and leisure group Pearson Plc rose on Thursday amid positive brokerage comment from NatWest Securities and Merrill Lynch, dealers said.
The stock was up 8p at 767-1/2 by 1145 GMT.

Market sources said Merrill analysts repeated an "accumulate" rating on the stock and raised earnings per shares estimates to 29.1p for 1996 and to 36.2p for 1997, though previous estimates were not immediately available.
NatWest analysts recommended the stock should be bought up to 800p, sources said.
Analysts at both brokerages were not immediately available for comment.
Marjorie Scardino took over as chief executive at Pearson last week amid hopes that she will lead a drive to increase shareholder returns through a focus on Pearson's core businesses.
A report in the Financial Times, owned by Pearson, said last week that Pearson and investment banking group Lazards may sell their cross-holdings.
